RANK 2: p2-evidence-validation-and-resources.md VALIDATION COMMANDS (156-222) and REVIEW EVIDENCE TEMPLATE (123-155) - add the recorded-literal guard: fail a port that writes three or more recorded values the original never spells out, mentions the recording files, has fewer tests or assertions than at the last passing gate, or runs on a changed cases.jsonl; // recorded-literal: <reason> is the escape

RANK 2: modeling-collections-and-api.md Collection Selection (140-153) and determinism-and-parity.md Acceptance Standard (36-50) - add fancy-regex for lookaround/backreferences and the non-ASCII trap: \w, \b, \d and case-insensitive matching differ from the source engine, so set unicode(false) or spell out ASCII classes where the original \w is ASCII-only

RANK 2: modeling-collections-and-api.md Conversion Policies (118-137) - add the UTF-16 code-unit rule: a JS char/Character/Char is a UTF-16 code unit, not a Unicode scalar, so refuse the conversion rather than mapping to Rust char; index a Vec<u16> where the original indexes by code unit

RANK 2: modeling-collections-and-api.md PUBLIC API AND ABI CONTRACTS (248-368) - add a C ABI Contract section after Sidecar Contract: int is std::ffi::c_int, an enum is c_int, a typedef of a scalar is that scalar, an all-scalar struct by value is #[repr(C)], and const char* is Option<&[u8]> which costs a strlen per argument

RANK 2: modeling-collections-and-api.md Canonical Serialization (212-247) - name the three serde_json features that close two of the four differences the set already warns about: float_roundtrip (recorded floats survive a parse and a write bit for bit), preserve_order (insertion order instead of sorted keys), unbounded_depth (no recursion limit); all three appear zero times in the set

RANK 2: p2-evidence-validation-and-resources.md VALIDATION COMMANDS (156-222) and build-and-organization.md Testing Layout (136-169) - state that cargo test passing with no tests proves nothing: the recorded cases are the proof

RANK 3: docs-errors-and-async.md ERROR AND PANIC TRANSLATION (124-219) - add an Application Entry Point section: fn main() -> ExitCode with an inner fn run() -> Result<ExitCode>, the error path returning a documented non-zero code rather than panicking; ExitCode appears zero times in the set, which is why the anyhow-in-main permission is only half a rule
